name: Lang & Lei
source:
The android butler and maid who manage the upkeep of the train. They work for Napoleon, but have some ability for free will. They are bound by Asimov's Laws for Robots however.
[From [url=https://teamotomegamejam.itch.io/the-algernon-affair]itch.io[/url]]
